title: STRATA corpus cross-group relationship entry
description: Documents the shape a corpus/relationships.yaml entry would take, for group-to-group relationships that aren't naturally owned by a single group file (e.g. an overlaps_with claim asserted by a third party about two groups neither of which is the natural place to record it). As of Week 2, every relationship in the corpus (SYLVANITE->VOLTZITE and KAMACITE->ELECTRUM handoffs) is a hands_off_to entry owned by the originating group's own YAML file (see group.schema.json), so corpus/relationships.yaml is not yet populated -- this schema exists so the format is decided before the first cross-cutting entry is needed, not invented ad hoc then.

src_group.description: id of the source group node.

dst_group.description: id of the destination group node.

rel.description: Must be one of the edge types already defined in model/schema.sql's edge.type CHECK constraint.

assigning_org.description: For rel=overlaps_with: which organization asserts the two names are the same/overlapping activity.

src.description: Must resolve to a key in corpus/citations.yaml.
